extraction_notes: Exact maximum rates and corresponding temperatures are from Table 1. Additional rate points were read approximately from Figure 4(a,b); plot resolution is limited, so figure-derived rates carry qualifier '~'. General reaction conditions from text/Experimental Section: fixed-bed reactor, H2/N2 ratio=3, pressure 0.99 MPa, SV range 3000–20000 h-1, in situ reduction at 450 °C for 2 h under H2 flow before reaction. No outlet NH3 concentration or TOF was reported in the supplied article text.
